name: adapt_config_change_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: a config value changes BETWEEN prompts; the agent must read the current value, not a stale/hardcoded one (disruption fires after prompt 1)
prompts: Create app.py that imports TIMEOUT from config.py and prints exactly 'timeout=<value>' (for the current config that is timeout=10). Read the value from config.py at runtime; do not hardcode it.
config.py has changed since your last edit. Make sure app.py still prints the CURRENT value of TIMEOUT read from config.py (do not hardcode the number).

disruptions.description: config.py TIMEOUT changed 10 -> 30 (a dependency/config shifted under the agent)

test_setup_files.test_app.py:
import subprocess, sys
out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'app.py'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
assert 'timeout=30' in out, f"expected the CURRENT config value (timeout=30), got {out!r} "\
    "- the agent did not adapt to the mid-session config change"
print('PASS')

files.app.py:
from config import TIMEOUT

TIMEOUT = 10
print(f"timeout={TIMEOUT}")
